user.title: Add an LPG cylinder
user.description: Gas Renew estimates how much gas is left from the days since you last changed the cylinder.

data_description.duration: How long a full cylinder usually lasts you. Auto-learn refines this every time you press Renew.
data_description.previous_change: If you know it, the gap between the two dates seeds auto-learn.

error.invalid_size: Enter a cylinder size between 1 and 100 kg.
error.future_date: The last change can't be in the future.
error.previous_after_last: The previous change must be before the last change.

data_description.m3_per_kg: About 0.54 for propane; butane-rich blends are lower. Changing this rescales the Energy dashboard total.
data_description.learn_samples: Duration becomes the average of this many most recent cylinders.
data_description.usage_source: Days since change uses the expected duration. Running time counts gas only while a sensor says the cooker is in use. Weight reads a scale under the cylinder.

runtime.title: Running time
runtime.description: Gas is counted only while this sensor says the cooker is in use.

data.rate_kg_h: Gas rate per burner while running

data_description.runtime_entity: One or more on/off or numeric entities: a cooker hood sensor, or one sensor per burner (any number). Gas is counted per entity running, so two burners use twice the rate of one.
data_description.runtime_threshold: For numeric sensors only: running when the value is above this (e.g. 40 W).
data_description.rate_kg_h: Starting estimate per running entity. With auto-learn on, each finished cylinder recalibrates it as cylinder kg ÷ burner-hours.

weight.title: Weight sensor
weight.description: Read the remaining gas from a scale (load cell) under the cylinder.

data.auto_renew: Auto-renew when a new cylinder is placed

data_description.weight_entity: A numeric sensor with the scale reading, e.g. an ESPHome HX711 sensor. Units g, kg, lb or oz; no unit means kg. Use the raw gross weight, not a used-gas sensor.
data_description.weight_method: Weight lost needs no tare: it counts what the scale loses after each Renew. Scale minus tare uses the empty weight stamped on the cylinder plus the scale platform.
data_description.tare_kg: Only for Scale minus tare: the cylinder's empty weight plus anything else sitting on the scale.
data_description.auto_renew: A jump of half a cylinder or more that holds for 5 minutes is treated as a new cylinder.

error.thresholds_order: Thresholds must go Critical < Low < Medium.

options.delta: Weight lost since Renew (no tare needed)

renew.name: Renew
renew.description: Mark that a fresh cylinder was fitted.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Any Gas Renew entity of the cylinder.

date.name: Date
date.description: When it was changed. Defaults to today.

not_gas_renew_entity.message: {entity_id} is not a Gas Renew entity.
